sanitizers.interpretation: No reported sanitizer violation does not establish absence of uninitialized reads; observed build-dependent behavior remains unresolved.

source_findings: WriteStrategy::run forms movement groups inside an OpenMP parallel loop.
AgentMove::pickIndex and formGroup invoke World::getRnd; getRnd draws from a single shared mt19937 without synchronization.
World declares minSpiceMetabolism and maxSpiceMetabolism, but its constructor never initializes either member.
Agent constructor calls getters for both bounds and passes them to getRnd when creating agents.
scope: Diagnostic evidence, not a completed study. One-thread repeatability is limited to the tested binary and two runs. No original source changes.
